comment: What each service promises (decision service-slos), read by tests/load/four-services.js for its thresholds and by scripts/measure-services.sh for the server-side numbers in a learner's own AWS account. Pledges' pledge latency and availability are the loop's Round 2 targets (R2.1); the rest are the course's design objectives. scripts/load-local.sh measures them locally; a learner measures them in their own AWS account (tests/load/README.md). ecsService and discoveryName are the names the service module gives each service (infra/modules/service: <name> and <name>-public). lagSeconds is the oldest message its queue may hold.

pledges.source: R2.1: 99.99%, pledge P99 < 200 ms; lag: 10 s, as infra/services/pledges pages on (s5-l13): the clients' retries after 1, 2 and 4 s reach a just-published campaign

campaigns.source: design objective: the catalog page, served from its cache

payments.source: design objective; settlement's pace is the PSP's (s3-a04), measured as the close pass

notifications.source: design objective: an email within five minutes of the event
